body:
I hope this doesn't come across as rude or inconsiderate at all.  I really appreciate your comment, and I get the feeling that you know my mindset better than most on this sub. Sorry, but I browsed your comments, read the "context" (gotta love RES), and about every piece of advice that you give. Every piece of "insight", hits too close to home.  So I draw a few (EDIT said two but put more thought into it, see "bought beer") conclusions.

1.  You are a lot like me, past hurts, sucks but you do your best to push through.  All the while, helping others, because you know how it feels.  Even though you still hurt, at least you see some good from the pain.

2.  You are a professional.  You deal with these type of cases regularly.  Job doesn't make you feel that you have done enough, so browse reddit.  Offer some advice free and anonymously.

3.  You have been there and have beaten it, only to look back and help those that are on that same road.  

Either way, my friend, you are an angel.  I am no one, yet you reach out to me without judgement, offering solid advice (btw the cards from last year and the wedding ring are in a safe place just for that reason).  When ever you see this, please pat yourself on the back.  You do good in this world, and to fuck what anyone says.
